outcome: preterm birth (extremely, very, moderately, spontaneous preterm labor, premature rupture of membranes, medically indicated)
cohort: The study included 43,056 women with live singleton births from 2017 through 2019.
finding: Maternal prepregnancy obesity was significantly associated with all phenotypes of preterm birth, with gestational diabetes mellitus and preeclampsia partially mediating this association.
gest_age: Preterm birth was defined as gestational age < 37 weeks (extremely < 28 weeks, very 28-31 weeks, moderately 32-36 weeks).
